chapters.title: When does an image become a world?
Welcome to AMCC 5160
Your teaching team is here to help you connect the lenses
Assessment rewards process, craft, judgment, and explanation
The weekly presentation turns your past work into shared course knowledge
Each class moves through four modes of attention
You already know more than you think
By the end, you can see the system and the artwork
This is one course with two inseparable lenses
Intent is visible in the decisions you can defend
Generative media belongs to a longer history of rule-making
Video is not an image with more frames
A durable map: data → representation → model → sampling
A dataset is a cultural archive with edges
Representation decides what the system can change smoothly
Latent space is less a library than a landscape
Diffusion learns to reverse corruption
Flow matching reframes generation as a learned motion
Transformers learn relationships across a sequence
A video model must bind appearance, time, and action
A model is a capability; a tool is a set of opinions
Prompt archaeology: reverse-engineer the decisions
Art direction is a system of relations, not a bag of adjectives
Constraints produce style when they are repeated deliberately
The creative loop is hypothesis, variation, selection, reflection
Failures reveal the model’s world—and sometimes your own
Name the failure before you fix it
Critique the intention, evidence, system, and next move
Authorship lives in the chain of decisions
Provenance turns process into inspectable evidence
Bias appears as defaults, absences, and uneven failure
A world model predicts what happens next under action
Studio challenge: direct one meaningful transformation
The semester moves from seeing to making to directing worlds
Your exit ticket is one sentence with a decision inside it
